create_lidar_instance: create a Lidar instance that connects to the RPLidar device at /dev/hello-lrf
start_lidar_scanning: start the Lidar scanning thread to continuously capture and store lidar scans
get_latest_lidar_scan: get the latest lidar scan as a tuple of timestamp and scan data
review_lidar_loop: review the lidar_loop method that iterates over scans and updates latest_scan with a lock
refactor_lidar_exception_handling: refactor the Lidar lidar_loop bare except clause to catch specific exceptions
